responsibility: Implements the compiler’s small fixed-arity formatted output layer on top of `FormatStrings` and `SFIO`. It expands format strings, translates `%a` arguments from `NameKey.Name` values into C strings before dispatch, writes the result to either a supplied file or `StdOut`, and provides the common printing helpers used by many gm2 support modules for traces, generated text, and non-GCC diagnostic output.
same_name_distinction: This `.mod` file implements the formatting layer by translating `%a` operands to strings, dispatching through `FormatStrings`, and writing to files or `StdOut`; the same-name `.def` file only exposes those printing entry points.
